naslov: NBA Roundup: Giannis’ double-double not enough against the Warriors
tekst:
By Eurohoops team/ info@eurohoops.net
Giannis Antetokounmpo had 20 points and 14 rebounds for Miami, which were not enough against the Golden State Warriors.
Stephen Curry scored 29 points, Yaxel Lendeborg added 17 points, eight rebounds, and six assists, and the Golden State Warriors won their sixth straight game by beating the Miami Heat 120-100.
The Greek Freak had help, as Davion Mitchell contributed 22 points and eight assists, and Bam Adebayo added 18 points and 10 rebounds for Miami, which was outscored 26-9 during one crucial stretch of the third quarter and couldn’t recover.
In Phoenix, Devin Booker scored 30 points, Dillon Brooks added 24, and the Suns snapped a four-game losing streak by beating the Orlando Magic 117-104.
Tristan da Silva scored 18 off the bench while Franz Wagner had 15 points and 15 assists, but the Magic had 25 turnovers, which the Suns turned into 36 points.
